# script usage interval

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:scriptUsageInterval`](gmeow-scriptUsageInterval.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/scriptUsageInterval>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/languages`](../../slices/languages.md)

The interval over which a writing-system-usage held — e.g. Turkish-in-Arabic-script until 1928. A relator carries its period this way (matching names' [`NameUsage`](../classes/gmeow-NameUsage.md)); lighter cases use gmeow:validFrom/validUntil on the statement. (Distinct from the names module's [`gmeow:usageInterval`](gmeow-usageInterval.md), which scopes a [`NameUsage`](../classes/gmeow-NameUsage.md).)
